note: One baked take in FBX/GLB (master timeline). Unity: split into clips by these frame ranges; loop=true clips are seamless.

clips.name: WarmUp
clips.desc: focus ring spins up 0 -> 180 deg, emitter glow grows

clips.name: Fire
clips.desc: continuous beam loop: core + sheath on (pulse), ring 1 rev / 24 f (6-fold symmetric, seamless)

clips.name: Heat
clips.desc: sustained fire: housing heat glow on, radiator fins open 35 deg, beam stays on

clips.name: Cooldown
clips.desc: trigger released: beam off, glow fades, fins stay open then close, ring coasts to rest

gameplay: Animation is visual only: it adds no gameplay capability, shot count or timing authority.
beam_note: Beam_Core is a 0.70 m visual stub; the gameplay beam (16 m, heat, cooling on release) stays in runtime code
